title: Molecular Identification of a Moricin Family Antimicrobial Peptide (Px-Mor) From Plutella xylostella With Activities Against the Opportunistic Human Pathogen Aureobasidium pullulans.

unavailable_sources: Supplementary Table S1 structure drawings are embedded non-text OOXML drawing content; text fields were parsed and the missing drawings are nonblocking for activity/database/mechanism conclusions.
materials_exhausted.note: Reopened handoff packet, XML/PDF tables, PDF text, OA package DOCX/JPEG/NXML/PDF members, local supplementary landing HTML, and DBAASP/APD6/CAMP JSONL rows.

adjudication_summary: Worker-2 recovered the full Table 1 MIC matrix and the previously skipped Table 2 hemolysis matrix. Worker-4 source-reviewed linked DBAASP/APD6/CAMP rows, verifying source-supported values while preserving target-name conflicts as cautions. Worker-6 closed rwk-complete-test-0001 with publication-grade acceptance only after strict gates passed.

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Packet material remains complete-with-gaps only for nonblocking supplementary drawing text extraction; XML/PDF/OA/database evidence needed for the gate was locally recoverable.

per_layer_decision_rationale.semantic_gate: Activity rows now have endpoint, raw value, unit, target species/strain, and locators; source_conflict database rows include explicit conflict context.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: {'source_verified': 74, 'source_conflict': 18} after source review; target-name conflicts are preserved rather than normalized away.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: 52 MIC rows and 40 hemolysis rows were recovered from primary XML/PDF tables with units and locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are limited to SEM/TEM A. pullulans membrane/morphology evidence, structural moricin context, and expression context.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: No blocking/major rework target remains; remaining cautions are explicit and nonblocking.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Supplementary Table S1 structure cells are embedded drawing/chemical-structure content and are blank in the OOXML text stream; names/accessions/pI/charge/MW/species are text-recovered.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: No activity, toxicity, database status, or mechanism decision depends on the unrecovered structure drawings; C-terminal amidation is supported by main-text synthesis methods.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP/CAMP rows use Pseudomonas fluorescens, Salmonella enterica, and Phytophthora litchii labels where the primary table uses Pseudomonas fluorescent, Salmonella choleraesuis, and Peronophythora litchi; values are matched but labels remain source_conflict.
Supplementary Table S1 structure drawings are not text-extractable from the DOCX; names/accessions/pI/charge/MW/species and main-text amidation statement were reviewed.
Final mechanism claims do not overextend SEM/TEM A. pullulans findings to every bacterial/fungal Table 1 target.
Table 2 melittin 100% hemolysis values are retained as control rows and not treated as Px-Mor toxicity.
